sql: with f as (select market_ticker, sum(quantity) as qty from live_orders where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and status='filled' and side='no' and action='buy' and limit_price between 90 and 95 group by 1), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, count(*) as mkts, sum(f.qty) as cts, sum(case when p.pos=0 then 1 else 0 end) as settled, round((sum(case when p.pos=0 then p.realized_pnl end)*100/nullif(sum(case when p.pos=0 then f.qty end),0))::numeric,2) as c_per_ct, sum(case when p.pos=0 and p.realized_pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) as losers from f left join p using (market_ticker) group by 1 having count(*)>=2 order by mkts desc limit 80
